mapper.sql: select cs.course_id, count(1) as total_section_count from osh_course_section cs where cs.delete_flag = 0 and cs.status = 1 group by cs.course_id

select lp.user_id, lp.course_id, count(distinct lp.section_id) as learned_section_count, coalesce(section_total.total_section_count, c.sub_count, 0) as total_section_count, round( case when coalesce(section_total.total_section_count, c.sub_count, 0) > 0 then sum(coalesce(lp.progress, 0)) / coalesce(section_total.total_section_count, c.sub_count, 0) else 0 end, 2 ) as progress_percent, case when coalesce(section_total.total_section_count, c.sub_count, 0) > 0 and count(distinct case when coalesce(lp.finish_time, null) is not null or coalesce(lp.progress, 0) >= 100 then lp.section_id end) >= coalesce(section_total.total_section_count, c.sub_count, 0) then 1 else 0 end as is_completed, min(lp.create_time) as first_learn_time, max(coalesce(lp.finish_time, lp.update_time, lp.create_time)) as last_learn_time, max(case when lp.status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as has_paused from osh_user_learn_progress lp left join osh_course c on c.id = lp.course_id and c.delete_flag = 0 left join (
) section_total on section_total.course_id = lp.course_id where lp.delete_flag = 0 group by lp.user_id, lp.course_id, section_total.total_section_count, c.sub_count
mapper.select:
select c.id as courseId, c.title as courseTitle, c.cover as courseCover, case when bought.course_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as purchasedFlag, case when p.course_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as startedFlag, coalesce(p.learned_section_count, 0) as learnedSectionCount, coalesce(p.total_section_count, 0) as totalSectionCount, coalesce(p.progress_percent, 0.00) as progressPercent, coalesce(p.is_completed, 0) as completedFlag, case when coalesce(p.is_completed, 0) = 1 then 3 when coalesce(p.has_paused, 0) = 1 then 2 when p.course_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as progressStatus, case when coalesce(p.is_completed, 0) = 1 then 'Completed' when coalesce(p.has_paused, 0) = 1 then 'Paused' when p.course_id is not null then 'Learning' else 'Not Started' end as progressStatusName, date_format(bought.purchase_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as purchaseTime, date_format(p.first_learn_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startLearnTime, date_format(p.last_learn_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastLearnTime from ( select base.course_id, min(base.purchase_time) as purchase_time from ( select ocb.course_id, ocb.pay_time as purchase_time from osh_course_buy ocb where ocb.user_id = #{userId} and ocb.pay_status = 'paid' and ocb.delete_flag = 0 union all select lp.course_id, min(lp.create_time) as purchase_time from osh_user_learn_progress lp where lp.user_id = #{userId} and lp.delete_flag = 0 group by lp.course_id ) base group by base.course_id ) bought inner join osh_course c on c.id = bought.course_id and c.delete_flag = 0 left join ( select agg.* from (
) agg where agg.user_id = #{userId} ) p on p.course_id = bought.course_id where 1 = 1
and p.course_id is not null
and c.title like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
order by coalesce(p.last_learn_time, bought.purchase_time) desc, c.id desc
select count(1) from osh_member_order where user_id = #{userId} and pay_status = 1 and delete_flag = 0
